summary: A framework for setting up multimedia sessions where network resource use must be authorized. It explains how session setup, such as with SIP, can be coordinated with quality of service reservations so that the media streams requested stay within the user's service profile and can be accounted for. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Before a phone call can use special fast lanes, someone has to check you are allowed and keep count of the use. This memo describes how the call setup and the lane reservation can work together.
